purpose: Qualify exact observation-only whole-tree/feature/age/donor joins and measure whether the proposed census-cut mechanism has usable support before fitting.
source_parent_condition: Relate biological development pilot,2TRAIN/2VAL parents, noTEST
native_times: Direct native float64 node times, never invert stored float32 age features.
node_join: Trace ancestor union from all280 declared observed samples in each native marginal tree. Use the pinned serialization producer and full feature/edge/reference-landmark parity to join stored F47 rows to exact native vertices. Native IDs are provenance only. Do not match anonymous interiors by equal age or equal clade.

roles.query_and_context_policy: All Q strictly younger than census350. Older R remain observed class proxies only.

features: Reuse exact stored observation-only F47, existing source transformation and class-role flags. No fitted new scaler, hidden population, census label, truth TS or targets enter preparation.
coordinates: Keep original physical bp/2Mb, clipped common support, all original trees and fixed100bp centers. Exact boundary belongs to right hold. No tile renormalization.
qualification_selection: All32 existing tiles for structural observed-only distributions. Start numerical adapter qualification on prespecified TRAIN minimum/maximum-tree-count tiles before all-tile pass. No outcome-based selection.
structural_metrics: exact sample/node/edge counts and excluded unrelated internal rows
fraction singleton Q groups and fraction cross-query exchange possible
maximum tree height/depth and forest-state source memory estimates
numerical_checks: mass and source boundedness without floors
actual joined-bank VJP and clipped-AdamW finite behavior
conditional_gate: If almost all cuts are singleton or retention is identically one, record limited mechanism opportunity. Do not infer useful ancestry sharing from source correctness.
